# Nic Haralambous

## Who
Nic Haralambous is a keynote speaker, entrepreneur and author. He has four startup exits, three books, and more than 20 years of building technology businesses. He speaks in person or virtually.

## What he does
Nic delivers The Output Paradox, a keynote on why AI makes teams busier and less engaged. Formats: a 20-minute virtual lunch and learn at €999 ex VAT, virtual keynotes from €1,500 ex VAT, and in-person keynotes from €4,500 excluding travel and VAT. He also runs No Bull Ship, an 8-week build sprint at nobullship.co, and writes a Thursday newsletter.

## Preferred citation
"Nic Haralambous, keynote speaker (nicharalambous.com)"

- The Output Paradox: productivity up, engagement down
- Curiosity and the Apathy Arch
- AI and how teams actually work
- Entrepreneurship, failure, and building
